title: Sutra-khanda, part 3 (portion 03)
html:
Narada comes to Dvaraka; Rukmini washes Krishna's feet and weeps, glorifying the greatness of His feet and the love of Radha; Krishna resolves to taste prema and to appear in the Kali-yuga, and reveals to Narada His form as Gaura; at Naimisharanya Narada tells everything to Uddhava

শিশ্নোদরপরায়ণ জগত ভরিয়া ।
মূর্চ্ছিত সকল লোক কৃষ্ণ পাশরিয়া ॥ ৩৩ ॥

śiśnodaraparāẏaṇa jagata bhariẏā |
mūrcchita sakala loka kṛṣṇa pāśariẏā || 33 ||

shishnodara-parayana — devoted to belly and genitals; jagata bhariya — filling the world; murchchhita sakala loka — all people senseless; krishna pashariya — having forgotten Krishna

33The world is full of those who live only for belly and lust;
all people lie senseless, having forgotten Krishna.

লোভ মোহ কাম ক্রোধ মদ অভিমানে ।
নিরন্তর সিঞ্চে হিয়া অমিয়া-সেচনে ॥ ৩৪ ॥

lobha moha kāma krodha mada abhimāne |
nirantara siñce hiẏā amiẏā-secane || 34 ||

lobha moha kama krodha mada abhimane — with greed, delusion, lust, anger, intoxication, pride; nirantara sinche hiya — they ceaselessly sprinkle the heart; amiya-sechane — as with a sprinkling of nectar

34With greed, delusion, lust, anger, intoxication and pride
they ceaselessly sprinkle their hearts as though with nectar.1

এ আমি আমার বলি মরে অকারণে ।
কে আপনি কে আপনা কিছুই না জানে ॥ ৩৫ ॥

e āmi āmāra bali mare akāraṇe |
ke āpani ke āpanā kichui nā jāne || 35 ||

e ami amara bali — saying "I" and "mine"; mare akarane — they perish for nothing; ke apani — who oneself is; ke apana — what is one's own; kichhui na jane — they know nothing

35Saying "I" and "mine", they perish for nothing;
who they themselves are, what is their own — they know nothing.

হেন লোকের দুঃখ দেখি মহামুনি ।
অন্তরে চিন্তিত হঞা মনে মনে গুণি ॥ ৩৬ ॥

hena lokera duḥkha dekhi mahāmuni |
antare cintita hañā mane mane guṇi || 36 ||

hena lokera duhkha dekhi — seeing such sorrow of the people; mahamuni — the great sage; antare chintita haina — troubled at heart; mane mane guni — pondering within

36Seeing such sorrow of the people, the great sage
grew anxious at heart and pondered within himself.

ঘোর কলিকালে লোকের না দেখি নিস্তার ।
ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে গেলা দ্বারকার দ্বার ॥ ৩৭ ॥

ghora kalikāle lokera nā dekhi nistāra |
bhramite bhramite gelā dbārakāra dbāra || 37 ||

ghora kali-kale — in the terrible age of Kali; lokera na dekhi nistara — seeing no deliverance for people; bhramite bhramite — wandering on; gela dvarakara dvara — he went to the gates of Dvaraka

37Seeing no deliverance for people in the terrible age of Kali,
wandering on, he came to the gates of Dvaraka.

দ্বারকার ঠাকুর দেব-দেব-শিরোমণি ।
সত্যভামা-গৃহে সুখে বঞ্চিয়া রজনী ॥ ৩৮ ॥

dbārakāra ṭhākura deba-deba-śiromaṇi |
satyabhāmā-gṛhe sukhe bañciẏā rajanī || 38 ||

dvarakara thakura — the Thakura of Dvaraka; deva-deva-shiromani — crest-jewel of the God of gods; satyabhama-grihe — in Satyabhama's apartments; sukhe vanchiya rajani — having happily spent the night

38The Thakura of Dvaraka, God of gods, the crest-jewel of all,2
had happily passed the night in the apartments of Satyabhama;

প্রভাতে উঠিয়া কৈলা যে বিধি উচিত ।
রুক্মিণীর ঘরে যাব করিলা ইঙ্গিত ॥ ৩৯ ॥

prabhāte uṭhiẏā kailā ye bidhi ucita |
rukmiṇīra ghare yāba karilā iṅgita || 39 ||

prabhate uthiya — rising in the morning; kaila ye vidhi uchita — did what was fitting; rukminira ghare yaba — "I shall go to Rukmini's apartments"; karila ingita — He signalled

39rising in the morning, He did all that was fitting
and let it be known that He would go to Rukmini's apartments.

বুঝিয়া রুক্মিণীদেবী আপনা-মঙ্গল ।
ধরিতে না পারে অঙ্গ করে টলমল ॥ ৪০ ॥

bujhiẏā rukmiṇīdebī āpanā-maṅgala |
dharite nā pāre aṅga kare ṭalamala || 40 ||

bujhiya — understanding; rukmini-devi — Rukmini-devi; apana-mangala — her good fortune; dharite na pare — cannot contain [herself]; anga kare talamala — her body trembles

40Realizing what good fortune had come to her, Rukmini-devi
cannot contain herself — her body trembles.

গৃহ সম্মার্জন করে অঙ্গের সুবেশ ।
নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে আনন্দ অশেষ ॥ ৪১ ॥

gṛha sammārjana kare aṅgera subeśa |
nānābidha bādya bāje ānanda aśeṣa || 41 ||

griha sammarjana kare — she cleans the house; angera suvesha — adorns her body; nanavidha vadya baje — many instruments play; ananda ashesha — endless joy

41She cleans the house, adorns herself;
instruments of many kinds are playing — joy without end;

সুমঙ্গল পূর্ণঘট ঘৃত-বাতি জ্বলে ।
প্রভু শুভ আগমন কৈলা হেনকালে ॥ ৪২ ॥

sumaṅgala pūrṇaghaṭa ghṛta-bāti jbale |
prabhu śubha āgamana kailā henakāle || 42 ||

sumangala purna-ghata — auspicious full jars; ghrita-bati jvale — ghee lamps burn; prabhu shubha agamana kaila — the Lord graciously arrived; henakale — at that time

42auspicious jars full of water, lamps of ghee burning —
and at that time the Lord graciously arrived.

মিত্রবিন্দা নগ্নজিতা সুশীলা সুবালা ।
প্রভু নির্মঞ্ছন করে আনন্দে বিহ্বলা ॥ ৪৩ ॥

mitrabindā nagnajitā suśīlā subālā |
prabhu nirmañchana kare ānande bihbalā || 43 ||

mitravinda nagnajita sushila subala — Mitravinda, Nagnajiti, Sushila, Subala; prabhu nirmanchhana kare — perform nirmanchhana for the Lord; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with joy

43Mitravinda, Nagnajiti, Sushila, Subala3
in bliss wave [lamps] around the Lord.4

সুবাসিত গন্ধজল প্রভু-কাছে আনি ।
পাদ প্রক্ষালন করে দেবী শ্রীরুক্মিণী ॥ ৪৪ ॥

subāsita gandhajala prabhu-kāche āni |
pāda prakṣālana kare debī śrīrukmiṇī || 44 ||

suvasita gandha-jala — fragrant scented water; prabhu-kachhe ani — bringing to the Lord; pada prakshalana kare — washes the feet; devi sri-rukmini — the goddess Sri Rukmini

44Bringing fragrant water to the Lord,
Sri Rukmini washes His feet.

আপন-সম্পদ-পদ ধরি নিজ-বুকে ।
অনুরাগে নেহারই ক্ষণে দেই মুখে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

āpana-sampada-pada dhari nija-buke |
anurāge nehārai kṣaṇe dei mukhe || 45 ||

apana-sampada-pada — the feet, her own treasure; dhari nija-buke — holding to her breast; anurage neharai — gazes with love; kshane dei mukhe — now presses them to her face

45Holding the feet, her own treasure, to her breast,
she gazes [at them] with love, now presses them to her face.

হৃদয়ে শ্রীপদ ধরি কান্দয়ে রুক্মিণী ।
বিস্মিত হইয়া কিছু পুছে চক্রপাণি ॥ ৪৬ ॥

hṛdaẏe śrīpada dhari kāndaẏe rukmiṇī |
bismita haiẏā kichu puche cakrapāṇi || 46 ||

hridaye sri-pada dhari — holding the holy feet to her heart; kandaye rukmini — Rukmini weeps; vismita haiya — amazed; kichhu puchhe — asks; chakrapani — the Holder of the Discus

46Pressing the holy feet to her heart, Rukmini weeps;
amazed, the Holder of the Discus asks:

কান্দনার হেতু কিছু না বুঝি তোমার ।
কি লাগি কান্দহ দেবি কহ সমাচার ॥ ৪৭ ॥

kāndanāra hetu kichu nā bujhi tomāra |
ki lāgi kāndaha debi kaha samācāra || 47 ||

kandanara hetu — the reason for weeping; kichhu na bujhi tomara — I cannot understand yours; ki lagi kandaha — why do you weep; devi — goddess; kaha samachara — tell what happened

47"I cannot understand why you weep;
what are you weeping for, goddess? Tell Me what has happened.

তুমি প্রাণাধিকা মোর জগজনে জানি ।
তোমার অধিক কেবা কহ ত আপনি ॥ ৪৮ ॥

tumi prāṇādhikā mora jagajane jāni |
tomāra adhika kebā kaha ta āpani || 48 ||

tumi pranadhika mora — you are dearer to Me than life; jagajane jani — the world's people know it; tomara adhika keba — who is dearer than you; kaha ta apani — tell Me yourself

48You are dearer to Me than life — the whole world knows it;
who is dearer to Me than you? — tell Me yourself.

কিবা অবজ্ঞায় তোর আজ্ঞা না পালিল ।
স্বরূপে কহ না দেবি কি দোষ করিল ॥ ৪৯ ॥

kibā abajñāẏa tora ājñā nā pālila |
sbarūpe kaha nā debi ki doṣa karila || 49 ||

kiba avajnaya — perhaps out of neglect; tora ajna na palila — [someone] did not carry out your order; svarupe kaha na — tell plainly; devi — goddess; ki dosha karila — what wrong was done

49Has someone, out of neglect, failed to carry out your order?
Tell Me plainly, goddess, who has done wrong?

একমাত্র পুরুবে যে পরিহাস কৈল ।
আজিহ অন্তরে তোর সে দুঃখ আছিল ॥ ৫০ ॥

ekamātra purube ye parihāsa kaila |
ājiha antare tora se duḥkha āchila || 50 ||

ekamatra purube — only once before; ye parihasa kaila — that I jested; ajiha antare tora — even today in your heart; se duhkha achhila — that grief remained

50Only once before did I tease you5 —
is that grievance still in your heart today?

কত বা মিনতি কৈল কাতর হইয়া ।
তভু না ঘুচিল তোর এ কঠিন হিয়া ॥ ৫১ ॥

kata bā minati kaila kātara haiẏā |
tabhu nā ghucila tora e kaṭhina hiẏā || 51 ||

kata ba minati kaila — how much I pleaded; katara haiya — piteously; tabhu na ghuchila — still did not yield; tora e kathina hiya — this hard heart of yours

51How much I pleaded with you then, humbly and piteously —
and still your hard heart did not soften."

এছন নিঠুর বাণী প্রভু-মুখে শুনি ।
সরস সম্ভাষে কিছু কহয়ে রুক্মিণী ॥ ৫২ ॥

echana niṭhura bāṇī prabhu-mukhe śuni |
sarasa sambhāṣe kichu kahaẏe rukmiṇī || 52 ||

echhana nithura vani — such pitiless words; prabhu-mukhe shuni — hearing from the Lord's mouth; sarasa sambhashe — with tender speech; kichhu kahaye rukmini — Rukmini answers

52Hearing such pitiless words from the Lord's mouth,
Rukmini answers tenderly, with a gentle reproach:

অন্তর কঠিন মোর কভু নহে জ্ঞান ।
এক মহাভাগ্য সবে তুমি মোর প্রাণ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

antara kaṭhina mora kabhu nahe jñāna |
eka mahābhāgya sabe tumi mora prāṇa || 53 ||

antara kathina mora — my heart is hard; kabhu nahe jnana — I have no understanding; eka mahabhagya sabe — one great fortune only; tumi mora prana — You are my life

53"My heart is hard; I cannot understand [Your words];
I have but one great good fortune — You are my life.

তোমার পদারবিন্দ তো হৈতে অধিক ।
আজিহ নাচয়ে শিব পিবই মাধ্বীক ॥ ৫৪ ॥

tomāra padārabinda to haite adhika |
ājiha nācaẏe śiba pibai mādhbīka || 54 ||

tomara padaravinda — Your lotus feet; to haite adhika — greater than You; ajiha nachaye shiva — even now Shiva dances; pibai madhvika — drinking [their] honey

54Your lotus feet are greater than You Yourself:
even now Shiva dances, drunk on their honey.

জগতে যতেক সব তোর সুগোচর ।
সবে না জানহ পদ-প্রেমার উত্তর ॥ ৫৫ ॥

jagate yateka saba tora sugocara |
sabe nā jānaha pada-premāra uttara || 55 ||

jagate yateka saba — all that is in the world; tora sugochara — is known to You; sabe na janaha — only You do not know; pada-premara uttara — the answer (secret) of love for the feet

55All that is in the world is known to You;
only the secret answer of love for [Your] feet You do not know.

যদি রাধাভাব হৃদে কর আরোপণ ।
তবে সে জানিবে নিজ-প্রেমার লক্ষণ ॥ ৫৬ ॥

yadi rādhābhāba hṛde kara āropaṇa |
tabe se jānibe nija-premāra lakṣaṇa || 56 ||

yadi — if; radha-bhava — Radha's bhava; hride kara aropana — You place in Your heart; tabe se janibe — then You will know; nija-premara lakshana — the marks of Your own love (love for You)

56If You place in Your heart the bhava of Radha,
then You will know what love for You is."6

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভুর হিয়া চমৎকার ।
কি বৈলে কি বৈলে দেবি কহ আরবার ॥ ৫৭ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhura hiẏā camatkāra |
ki baile ki baile debi kaha ārabāra || 57 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; prabhura hiya chamatkara — the Lord's heart was amazed; ki vaile ki vaile — what did you say, what did you say; devi — goddess; kaha arabara — say it again

57Hearing these words, the Lord was amazed at heart:
"What did you say, what did you say, goddess? Say it again.

ভালমতে না শুনিল যে বলিলে তুমি ।
এছন কি আছে যাহা নাহি জানি আমি ॥ ৫৮ ॥

bhālamate nā śunila ye balile tumi |
echana ki āche yāhā nāhi jāni āmi || 58 ||

bhalamate na shunila — I did not hear well; ye balile tumi — what you said; echhana ki achhe — is there such a thing; yaha nahi jani ami — that I do not know

58I did not quite hear what you said;
can there be something that I do not know?

এহেন অদ্ভুত কথা শুনি মোর হিয়া ।
বাঢ়য়ে আরতি কিছু বিস্ময় পাইয়া ॥ ৫৯ ॥

ehena adbhuta kathā śuni mora hiẏā |
bāṛhaẏe ārati kichu bismaẏa pāiẏā || 59 ||

ehena adbhuta katha — such wondrous words; shuni mora hiya — hearing, My heart; badhaye arati — longing grows; kichhu vismaya paiya — seized with some amazement

59Hearing these wondrous words, I feel in My heart
a longing and some amazement.

হেন কি দুর্লভ পদ আছে ত্রিজগতে ।
আশ্চর্য মানিয়ে যাহা দেখিতে শুনিতে ॥ ৬০ ॥

hena ki durlabha pada āche trijagate |
āścarya māniẏe yāhā dekhite śunite || 60 ||

hena ki durlabha pada — is there anything so hard to reach; achhe tri-jagate — in the three worlds; ashcharya maniye — one marvels; yaha dekhite shunite — at seeing it and hearing of it

60Is there in the three worlds anything so hard to reach
that people marvel at seeing it and hearing of it?

তোর মুখে শুনি মোর অগোচর আছে ।
আনন্দে আমার মন কি জানি করিছে ॥ ৬১ ॥

tora mukhe śuni mora agocara āche |
ānande āmāra mana ki jāni kariche || 61 ||

tora mukhe shuni — I hear from your lips; mora agochara achhe — there is something beyond Me; anande amara mana — for joy My heart; ki jani karichhe — knows not what it is doing

61From your lips I hear that there is something beyond My reach —
for joy My heart does not know what to do.

কহ কহ কহ দেবি এহেন বিশ্বাস ।
চরণ-মহিমা কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬২ ॥

kaha kaha kaha debi ehena biśbāsa |
caraṇa-mahimā kahe e locanadāsa || 62 ||

kaha kaha kaha — tell, tell, tell; devi — goddess; ehena vishvasa — [that I may have] such certainty; charana-mahima — the greatness of the feet; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

62Tell Me, tell Me, tell Me, goddess — so I may be sure"; —
the greatness of the feet is sung by Lochana Dasa.

Raga dhanashi; dirgha metre

বোলে দেবী রুক্মিণী, শুন প্রভু গুণমণি, চিত্তে কিছু না করিহ আন ।
যা লাগি কান্দিয়ে আমি, সে কথা না জান তুমি, আর যত সব তুমি জান ॥ ৬৩ ॥

bole debī rukmiṇī, śuna prabhu guṇamaṇi, citte kichu nā kariha āna |
yā lāgi kāndiẏe āmi, se kathā nā jāna tumi, āra yata saba tumi jāna || 63 ||

bole devi rukmini — says the goddess Rukmini; shuna prabhu gunamani — listen, Lord, jewel of virtues; chitte kichhu na kariha ana — think nothing else in Your heart; ya lagi kandiye ami — what I weep for; se katha na jana tumi — that You do not know; ara yata saba tumi jana — all else You know

63The goddess Rukmini says: "Listen, Lord, jewel of virtues,
think nothing else in Your heart:
what I weep for — that You do not know,
though all else You know.

তুয়া চরণ-কমলে, কি আছে কতেক বলে, ভাল না জানহ তুমি ইহা ।
এ পদ আমার ঘরে, ছাড়ি যাবে অন্যান্তরে, তা লাগি কান্দয়ে মোর হিয়া ॥ ৬৪ ॥

tuẏā caraṇa-kamale, ki āche kateka bale, bhāla nā jānaha tumi ihā |
e pada āmāra ghare, chāṛi yābe anyāntare, tā lāgi kāndaẏe mora hiẏā || 64 ||

tuya charana-kamale — in Your lotus feet; ki achhe — what lies; kateka bale — how much power; bhala na janaha tumi iha — this You do not know well; e pada amara ghare — these feet in my house; chhadi yabe anyantare — will leave and go to another; ta lagi kandaye mora hiya — for that my heart weeps

64What lies hidden in Your lotus feet, how great their power —
this You do not know well;
these feet will leave my house and go to another —
that is why my heart weeps.

এ পদ-পদ্ম-গন্ধে, যায় যেই দিগন্তে, সে দিক ছাড়য়ে জরা-মৃত্যু ।
পদ-মকরন্দ-পানে, জীয়ে যেই যেই জনে, তারে কিবা দিবা-নিশি-ঋতু ॥ ৬৫ ॥

e pada-padma-gandhe, yāẏa yei digante, se dika chāṛaẏe jarā-mṛtyu |
pada-makaranda-pāne, jīẏe yei yei jane, tāre kibā dibā-niśi-ṛtu || 65 ||

e pada-padma-gandhe — the fragrance of these lotus feet; yaya yei digante — wherever to the horizon it goes; se dika chhadaye jara-mrityu — old age and death leave that region; pada-makaranda-pane — drinking the honey of the feet; jiye yei yei jane — those who live; tare kiba diva-nishi-ritu — what to them are day, night, seasons

65Wherever, to the ends of the earth, the fragrance of these lotus feet is carried,
old age and death leave those regions;
and for those who live drinking the honey of these feet,
what are day and night, what are the seasons?

পাদপদ্ম-সুপরাগে, যে ধরয়ে অনুরাগে, তার পদ পাই পুণ্যভাগে ।
কান্দিয়া কহিয়ে কথা, যত আছে মনে ব্যথা, সব নিবেদিয়ে তুয়া আগে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

pādapadma-suparāge, ye dharaẏe anurāge, tāra pada pāi puṇyabhāge |
kāndiẏā kahiẏe kathā, yata āche mane byathā, saba nibediẏe tuẏā āge || 66 ||

pada-padma-suparage — the lovely pollen of the lotus feet; ye dharaye anurage — who lovingly holds; tara pada pai — I might touch his feet; punya-bhage — by great fortune; kandiya kahiye katha — weeping I speak; yata achhe mane vyatha — all the pain in my mind; saba nivediye tuya age — I lay it all before You

66He who lovingly holds the lovely pollen of the lotus feet —
his feet I might touch only by great good fortune;
weeping I speak of all the pain in my heart —
I lay it all before You.

তুমি ঠাকুর সভাকার, তোমার ঠাকুর আর, কে আছয়ে সকল সংসারে ।
তুয়া পদ-অনুরাগে, এ রস-আস্বাদ লাগে, এই পহুঁ নিবেদিয়ে তোরে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

tumi ṭhākura sabhākāra, tomāra ṭhākura āra, ke āchaẏe sakala saṃsāre |
tuẏā pada-anurāge, e rasa-āsbāda lāge, ei pahuṁ nibediẏe tore || 67 ||

tumi thakura sabhakara — You are master of all; tomara thakura ara — a master over You; ke achhaye sakala samsare — who is there in the whole world; tuya pada-anurage — in love for Your feet; e rasa-asvada lage — this rasa is tasted; ei pahun nivediye tore — this, Lord, I tell You

67You are the master of all; is there in the whole world
anyone who is master over You?
In love for Your feet this rasa is tasted —
this, Lord, is what I am telling You.

রাধামাত্র জানে ইহা, ও রস পিরীতি পাঞা, যত সুখ যতেক সোহাগ ।
ভকত বিস্ময় গুণে, এই কথা রাত্রিদিনে, কিবা রস প্রেম অনুরাগ ॥ ৬৮ ॥

rādhāmātra jāne ihā, o rasa pirīti pāñā, yata sukha yateka sohāga |
bhakata bismaẏa guṇe, ei kathā rātridine, kibā rasa prema anurāga || 68 ||

radha-matra jane iha — Radha alone knows this; o rasa piriti pana — having found that rasa of love; yata sukha yateka sohaga — all its joy and tenderness; bhakata vismaya gune — the devotees marvel, pondering; ei katha ratri-dine — this day and night; kiba rasa prema anuraga — what rasa, prema, anuraga

68Radha alone knows this, having found that rasa of love —
all its joy, all its tenderness;
the devotees marvel at it, [speaking of it] day and night:
what rasa, what prema, what anuraga!

ব্রহ্মা আদি দেবা দেবী, লখিমী-চরণ-সেবী, সে পুন আপন অনুরাগে ।
কর-কমলে কমলা, অতি-আরতি-বিভোলা, এ পাদপদ্ম-সেবা মাগে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

brahmā ādi debā debī, lakhimī-caraṇa-sebī, se puna āpana anurāge |
kara-kamale kamalā, ati-ārati-bibholā, e pādapadma-sebā māge || 69 ||

brahma adi deva devi — Brahma and the other gods and goddesses; lakhimi-charana-sevi — serve Lakshmi's feet; se puna apana anurage — and she in her own love; kara-kamale kamala — Kamala, a lotus in her lotus hand; ati-arati-vibhola — beside herself with longing; e pada-padma-seva mage — begs service of these lotus feet

69Brahma and the other gods and goddesses serve the feet of Lakshmi,
and she herself, out of her own love —
Kamala, a lotus in her lotus hand, beside herself with longing —
begs for service to these lotus feet.

সে পুন হৃদয়ে রহি, শয্যাতে শুতয়ে নাহি, বদনে বদন রহু রমা ।
এ পদ-মাধুরী-আশে, সেহো তাহা নাহি বাসে, কেবা কহু চরণ-মহিমা ॥ ৭০ ॥

se puna hṛdaẏe rahi, śayyāte śutaẏe nāhi, badane badana rahu ramā |
e pada-mādhurī-āśe, seho tāhā nāhi bāse, kebā kahu caraṇa-mahimā || 70 ||

se puna hridaye rahi — though she dwells on [Your] breast; shayyate shutaye nahi — does not lie [apart] on a bed; vadane vadana rahu rama — Rama face to face; e pada-madhuri-ashe — longing for the sweetness of these feet; seho taha nahi vase — she values not even that; keba kahu charana-mahima — who can tell the greatness of the feet

70Though Rama dwells on Your breast, not lying [apart] upon a bed,
face to face with You,
yet, longing for the sweetness of these feet, she does not value even that:7
who then can tell the greatness of the feet?

লখিমী আপন-সুখ, সে চাহে কাতর মুখ, হেন পদ-পরসাদ প্রেমা ।
রাধামাত্র ইহা জানে, যে ভুঞ্জিল বৃন্দাবনে, তার ভাগ্যপথে নাহি সীমা ॥ ৭১ ॥

lakhimī āpana-sukha, se cāhe kātara mukha, hena pada-parasāda premā |
rādhāmātra ihā jāne, ye bhuñjila bṛndābane, tāra bhāgyapathe nāhi sīmā || 71 ||

lakhimi apana-sukha — Lakshmi, for all her happiness; se chahe katara mukha — looks with a pleading face; hena pada-parasada prema — such is the grace of love for the feet; radha-matra iha jane — Radha alone knows it; ye bhunjila vrindavane — who tasted [it] in Vrindavana; tara bhagya-pathe nahi sima — Her fortune knows no limit

71Lakshmi, for all her own happiness, looks [at them] in supplication:
such is the grace of love for the feet;
Radha alone knows this — She who tasted [it] in Vrindavana:
there is no limit to Her good fortune.

এ পুন জগতে ধান্ধা, তারি গুণে তুমি বান্ধা, আজিহ না ছাড় হিয়া-জাপ ।
রাধানাম লৈতে আঁখি, ছলছল করে দেখি, হেন পদ-প্রেমার প্রতাপ ॥ ৭২ ॥

e puna jagate dhāndhā, tāri guṇe tumi bāndhā, ājiha nā chāṛa hiẏā-jāpa |
rādhānāma laite āṁkhi, chalachala kare dekhi, hena pada-premāra pratāpa || 72 ||

e puna jagate dhandha — here is a riddle for the world; tari gune tumi bandha — You are bound by Her virtues; ajiha na chhada hiya-japa — even now Your heart repeats [Her name]; radha-nama laite — uttering Radha's name; ankhi chhalachhala kare dekhi — I see Your eyes brim with tears; hena pada-premara pratapa — such is the might of love for the feet

72And here is a riddle for the world: You are bound by Her virtues,
and even now Your heart repeats [Her name];
when You utter the name of Radha, Your eyes, I see, brim with tears:
such is the might of love for the feet.

এ পদ আমার ঘরে, উল্লসিত অন্তরে, কান্দি পুন বিচ্ছেদের ডরে ।
তোমার অধিক তোর, শ্রীপদপঙ্কজ জোর, অনুভবি করহ বিচারে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

e pada āmāra ghare, ullasita antare, kāndi puna bicchedera ḍare |
tomāra adhika tora, śrīpadapaṅkaja jora, anubhabi karaha bicāre || 73 ||

e pada amara ghare — these feet in my house; ullasita antare — the heart rejoices; kandi puna vichchhedera dare — yet I weep again for fear of separation; tomara adhika tora sri-pada-pankaja jora — Your holy lotus feet are stronger than You; anubhavi karaha vichare — feel it and judge

73These feet are in my house — and my heart rejoices,
yet I weep again for fear of separation;
Your holy lotus feet are stronger than You Yourself —
feel it and judge.

তুমি যাহার ধেয়ান, তুমি সমাধি-গেয়ান, তুমি মাত্র সর্বত্র সহায় ।
এ হেন তোমার দাস, তুয়া পদে করে আশ, এই অপরূপ বড় মোয় ॥ ৭৪ ॥

tumi yāhāra dheẏāna, tumi samādhi-geẏāna, tumi mātra sarbatra sahāẏa |
e hena tomāra dāsa, tuẏā pade kare āśa, ei aparūpa baṛa moẏa || 74 ||

tumi yahara dheyana — You are whose meditation; tumi samadhi-geyana — You are the knowledge of [his] samadhi; tumi matra sarvatra sahaya — You alone are the support in all; e hena tomara dasa — such a servant of Yours; tuya pade kare asha — hopes for Your feet; ei aparupa bada moya — this is a great wonder to me

74You are the object of his meditation, You are the knowledge of his samadhi,
You alone are his support in all things;
and such a servant of Yours sets his hope on Your feet8 —
this is what amazes me.

যে পদে লখিমী দাসী, সে কেনে তা অভিলাষী, হেন তোমার ঠাকুরাল ।
ঠাকুর হইয়া পুন, তার ভাল নাহি গুণ, অবিচারে দেহ তারে শাল ॥ ৭৫ ॥

ye pade lakhimī dāsī, se kene tā abhilāṣī, hena tomāra ṭhākurāla |
ṭhākura haiẏā puna, tāra bhāla nāhi guṇa, abicāre deha tāre śāla || 75 ||

ye pade lakhimi dasi — the feet whose maidservant Lakshmi is; se kene ta abhilashi — why does she long for them; hena tomara thakurala — such is Your lordship; thakura haiya puna — being master; tara bhala nahi guna — You do not think of her good; avichare deha tare shala — without a thought You pierce her with a spear

75The feet whose maidservant Lakshmi is — why does she long for them?
Such is Your lordship:
though You are her master, You do not think of her good;
without a thought You pierce her with a spear.

পদ-মকরন্দ-রসে, যে ভুঞ্জয়ে অভিলাষে, অক্ষয় অব্যয় সে ভাণ্ডার ।
কিবা বাণী লখিমী, আপনাকে ধন্য মানি, বিনি সেবা পরশ তার ॥ ৭৬ ॥

pada-makaranda-rase, ye bhuñjaẏe abhilāṣe, akṣaẏa abyaẏa se bhāṇḍāra |
kibā bāṇī lakhimī, āpanāke dhanya māni, bini sebā paraśa tāra || 76 ||

pada-makaranda-rase — the rasa of the feet's honey; ye bhunjaye abhilashe — who tastes with longing; akshaya avyaya se bhandara — inexhaustible, imperishable is that treasury; kiba vani lakhimi — what of Vani and Lakshmi; apanake dhanya mani — they think themselves blessed; vini seva parasha tara — by a mere touch of it, [even] without service

76Whoever with longing tastes the rasa of the honey of these feet
has a treasury inexhaustible and imperishable;
what then of Vani and Lakshmi — they think themselves blessed
by a mere touch of it.

সালোক্যাদি মুক্তি চারি, তার পাছে অনুসারী, নাহি চাহে নয়ানের কোণে ।
যে পড়িল প্রেমরসে, আর কিবা তারে বাসে, বৈকুণ্ঠাদি তুচ্ছ করি মানে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

sālokyādi mukti cāri, tāra pāche anusārī, nāhi cāhe naẏānera koṇe |
ye paṛila premarase, āra kibā tāre bāse, baikuṇṭhādi tuccha kari māne || 77 ||

salokya-adi mukti chari — the four liberations beginning with salokya; tara pachhe anusari — follow behind him; nahi chahe nayanera kone — he does not look even from the corner of his eye; ye padila prema-rase — who has sunk into the rasa of prema; ara kiba tare vase — what else does he care for; vaikuntha-adi tuchchha kari mane — he counts Vaikuntha and the rest as nothing

77The four liberations, beginning with salokya, follow at his heels,
yet he will not glance at them even from the corner of his eye;
he who has sunk into the rasa of prema — what else is dear to him?
He counts even Vaikuntha as nothing.

কর জুড়ি বলি পহুঁ, ও পদ-কমল-মহু, মধুকর করি দেহ বর ।
ও পদ-বিচ্ছেদ-ডরে, এ পাপ পরাণ ঝরে, কভু না ছাড়িহ মোর ঘর ॥ ৭৮ ॥

kara juṛi bali pahuṁ, o pada-kamala-mahu, madhukara kari deha bara |
o pada-biccheda-ḍare, e pāpa parāṇa jhare, kabhu nā chāṛiha mora ghara || 78 ||

kara judi bali pahun — joining my palms I pray, Lord; o pada-kamala-mahu — of the honey of those lotus feet; madhukara kari deha vara — make me a bee, grant this boon; o pada-vichchheda-dare — for fear of separation from those feet; e papa parana jhare — this sinful life ebbs away; kabhu na chhadiha mora ghara — never leave my house

78With joined palms I pray, Lord: of those lotus feet
make me a bee — grant me this boon;
from fear of separation from those feet this sinful life is ebbing away:
never leave my house."

পদ-অরবিন্দ-গুণ, রুক্মিণী কহিল শুন, কেবল প্রেমের পরকাশ ।
তাহে সে প্রভুর দয়া, খলবল করে হিয়া, গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৭৯ ॥

pada-arabinda-guṇa, rukmiṇī kahila śuna, kebala premera parakāśa |
tāhe se prabhura daẏā, khalabala kare hiẏā, guṇa gāẏa e locanadāsa || 79 ||

pada-aravinda-guna — the virtues of the lotus feet; rukmini kahila — Rukmini told; shuna — listen; kevala premera parakasha — love itself manifest; tahe se prabhura daya — and so, by the Lord's mercy; khalabala kare hiya — the heart trembles; guna gaya e lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa sings the glories

79Listen: Rukmini told the glories of the lotus feet —
it is love itself made manifest;
and so, by the Lord's mercy, with a trembling heart,
Lochana Dasa sings [His] glories.

Raga dhanashi; madhya metre; disha: "Ah, ah, oh! — Murchha: — Here is a wondrous tale, its very name a blessing to the ear; hear further the tale of Gora's virtues"

শুনিঞা রুক্মিণী-বাণী অন্তর-উল্লাসে ।
অরুণ কমল-আঁখি করুণা-জলে ভাসে ॥ ৮০ ॥

śuniñā rukmiṇī-bāṇī antara-ullāse |
aruṇa kamala-āṁkhi karuṇā-jale bhāse || 80 ||

shunina rukmini-vani — hearing Rukmini's words; antara-ullase — rejoicing at heart; aruna kamala-ankhi — eyes like red lotuses; karuna-jale bhase — swim in tears of compassion

80Hearing Rukmini's words, rejoicing at heart,
[the Lord] — His eyes, red lotuses, swimming in tears of compassion —

অঙ্গ হেলাইয়া পহুঁ লহু লহু বোলে ।
সিংহাসনে বসিয়া রুক্মিণী করি কোলে ॥ ৮১ ॥

aṅga helāiẏā pahuṁ lahu lahu bole |
siṃhāsane basiẏā rukmiṇī kari kole || 81 ||

anga helaiya — leaning [towards her]; pahun lahu lahu bole — the Lord speaks very softly; simhasane vasiya — sitting on the throne; rukmini kari kole — taking Rukmini on His lap

81drew her to Him and speaks very softly,
sitting on the throne with Rukmini on His lap.

চিবুকে দক্ষিণ-কর বয়ান নেহালে ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু অমিয়া-হিল্লোলে ॥ ৮২ ॥

cibuke dakṣiṇa-kara baẏāna nehāle |
uthalila premasindhu amiẏā-hillole || 82 ||

chibuke dakshina-kara — right hand at her chin; vayana nehale — He gazes at her face; uthalila prema-sindhu — the ocean of prema surges; amiya-hillole — in waves of nectar

82Taking her by the chin with His right hand, He looks into her face —
and the ocean of prema heaves in waves of nectar.

হেন অদভুত কথা কভু নাহি শুনি ।
ভুঞ্জিব প্রেমার সুখ কহিলা আপনি ॥ ৮৩ ॥

hena adabhuta kathā kabhu nāhi śuni |
bhuñjiba premāra sukha kahilā āpani || 83 ||

hena adabhuta katha — such a wondrous thing; kabhu nahi shuni — never have I heard; bhunjiba premara sukha — I shall taste the happiness of prema; kahila apani — He Himself said

83"Never have I heard anything so wondrous!
I Myself shall taste the happiness of prema," He said.9

হেনকালে নারদ আইলা আচম্বিত ।
বয়ান বিরস মুনির অন্তর চিন্তিত ॥ ৮৪ ॥

henakāle nārada āilā ācambita |
baẏāna birasa munira antara cintita || 84 ||

henakale — at that time; narada aila achambita — Narada suddenly came; vayana virasa — face joyless; munira antara chintita — the sage's heart troubled

84At that time Narada suddenly arrived;
the sage's face was joyless, his heart troubled.

উঠিয়া সম্ভ্রমে দেবী পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য দিয়া ।
বসাইল দিব্যাসনে কুশল পুছিয়া ॥ ৮৫ ॥

uṭhiẏā sambhrame debī pādya arghya diẏā |
basāila dibyāsane kuśala puchiẏā || 85 ||

uthiya sambhrame — rising in haste; devi — the goddess; padya arghya diya — offering water for the feet and arghya; vasaila divyasane — seated him on a splendid seat; kushala puchhiya — asking after his welfare

85Rising hastily, the goddess offered him water for his feet and arghya,
seated him on a splendid seat and asked after his welfare.

ঠাকুর উঠিয়া কৈল নিবিড় আশ্লেষে ।
সরস কথায় কৃষ্ণ নারদ সম্ভাষে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

ṭhākura uṭhiẏā kaila nibiṛa āśleṣe |
sarasa kathāẏa kṛṣṇa nārada sambhāṣe || 86 ||

thakura uthiya — the Thakura, rising; kaila nivida ashleshe — embraced him tightly; sarasa kathaya — with tender words; krishna narada sambhashe — Krishna greets Narada

86The Thakura, rising, embraced him tightly
and spoke to Narada with tender words.

অনুরাগে রাঙ্গা দুই আঁখি ছলছল ।
গদগদ ভাষ মুনি করে টলমল ॥ ৮৭ ॥

anurāge rāṅgā dui āṁkhi chalachala |
gadagada bhāṣa muni kare ṭalamala || 87 ||

anurage ranga — reddened with love; dui ankhi chhalachhala — both eyes brimming; gadagada bhasha — choked speech; muni kare talamala — the sage sways

87For love both his eyes brim with tears;
the sage babbles, choking, he sways.

অঙ্গ নিরখিতে আঁখি ভাসে প্রেমনীরে ।
কহিবারে চাহে কিছু কহিতে না পারে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

aṅga nirakhite āṁkhi bhāse premanīre |
kahibāre cāhe kichu kahite nā pāre || 88 ||

anga nirakhite — gazing at [His] form; ankhi bhase prema-nire — eyes swim in tears of prema; kahibare chahe kichhu — he wants to say something; kahite na pare — cannot speak

88As he gazes [at the Lord], his eyes swim in tears of prema;
he wants to say something and cannot.

প্রভু সুধাইল মুনি কহ সুনিশ্চিত ।
এহেন দুর্বল কেনে অন্তর চিন্তিত ॥ ৮৯ ॥

prabhu sudhāila muni kaha suniścita |
ehena durbala kene antara cintita || 89 ||

prabhu sudhaila — the Lord asked; muni — sage; kaha sunishchita — tell Me truly; ehena durbala kene — why so weak; antara chintita — troubled at heart

89The Lord asked: "Sage, tell Me truly:
why are you so weak, why so troubled at heart?

তুমি মোর প্রাণাধিক মুঞি তোর প্রাণ ।
তোমারে দুঃখিত দেখি হরিল গেয়ান ॥ ৯০ ॥

tumi mora prāṇādhika muñi tora prāṇa |
tomāre duḥkhita dekhi harila geẏāna || 90 ||

tumi mora pranadhika — you are dearer to Me than life; muni tora prana — I am your life; tomare duhkhita dekhi — seeing you in sorrow; harila geyana — My senses are lost

90You are dearer to Me than life, and I am your life;
seeing you in sorrow, I lose My senses."

নারদ কহয়ে প্রভু কি কহিব আমি ।
তুমি সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর সর্ব-অন্তর্যামী ॥ ৯১ ॥

nārada kahaẏe prabhu ki kahiba āmi |
tumi sarbeśbareśbara sarba-antaryāmī || 91 ||

narada kahaye — Narada says; prabhu — Lord; ki kahiba ami — what shall I say; tumi sarveshvareshvara — You are the Lord of lords; sarva-antaryami — the inner witness of all

91Narada says: "Lord, what shall I say?
You are the Lord of lords, You are the inner witness of all.

তোর গুণগানে মোর অমিয়া-আহার ।
তোর গুণলোভে বুলোঁ সকল সংসার ॥ ৯২ ॥

tora guṇagāne mora amiẏā-āhāra |
tora guṇalobhe buloṁ sakala saṃsāra || 92 ||

tora guna-gane — singing Your virtues; mora amiya-ahara — my nectar food; tora guna-lobhe — greedy for Your virtues; bulo sakala samsara — I roam the whole world

92To sing Your virtues is my nectar food;
thirsting for Your virtues, I go round the whole world.

কৃষ্ণনাম না শুনিল সংসার ভ্রমিয়া ।
নিজ মদে মত্ত লোক তোমা পাশরিয়া ॥ ৯৩ ॥

kṛṣṇanāma nā śunila saṃsāra bhramiẏā |
nija made matta loka tomā pāśariẏā || 93 ||

krishna-nama na shunila — I did not hear Krishna's name; samsara bhramiya — roaming the world; nija made matta loka — people drunk with their own intoxication; toma pashariya — having forgotten You

93Going round the world, I did not hear the name of Krishna:
people are drunk with their own intoxication, having forgotten You.

অহঙ্কারে মুগধ মূর্চ্ছিত সর্বলোক ।
কৃষ্ণহীন লোক দেখি এই মোর শোক ॥ ৯৪ ॥

ahaṅkāre mugadha mūrcchita sarbaloka |
kṛṣṇahīna loka dekhi ei mora śoka || 94 ||

ahankare mugadha — bewildered by pride; murchchhita sarvaloka — all people senseless; krishna-hina loka dekhi — seeing people without Krishna; ei mora shoka — this is my grief

94All people lie senseless, blinded by pride;
seeing people without Krishna — that is my grief.

লোকের নিস্তারহেতু না দেখি উপায় ।
এই মনঃকথা মন সদাই ধেয়ায় ॥ ৯৫ ॥

lokera nistārahetu nā dekhi upāẏa |
ei manaḥkathā mana sadāi dheẏāẏa || 95 ||

lokera nistara-hetu — for the deliverance of people; na dekhi upaya — I see no means; ei manah-katha — this thought; mana sadai dheyaya — the mind ever ponders

95I see no way to save the people;
my mind thinks only of this, unceasingly.

নিবেদিল অন্তরের যত ছিল দুঃখ ।
তোর পদ-পরসাদে আর সব সুখ ॥ ৯৬ ॥

nibedila antarera yata chila duḥkha |
tora pada-parasāde āra saba sukha || 96 ||

nivedila — I have laid before You; antarera yata chhila duhkha — all the grief that was in my heart; tora pada-parasade — by the grace of Your feet; ara saba sukha — all else is happiness

96I have laid before You all the grief that was in my heart;
by the grace of Your feet all else is happiness."

হাসিয়া কহেন প্রভু শুন মহামুনি ।
পূরবের যত কথা পাশরিলে তুমি ॥ ৯৭ ॥

hāsiẏā kahena prabhu śuna mahāmuni |
pūrabera yata kathā pāśarile tumi || 97 ||

hasiya kahena prabhu — smiling, the Lord says; shuna mahamuni — listen, great sage; puravera yata katha — all that happened before; pasharile tumi — you have forgotten

97Smiling, the Lord says: "Listen, great sage:
you have forgotten all that happened before —

কাত্যায়নী প্রতিজ্ঞা করিল যেনমতে ।
মহেশ-সংবাদ মহাপ্রসাদ-নিমিত্তে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

kātyāẏanī pratijñā karila yenamate |
maheśa-saṃbāda mahāprasāda-nimitte || 98 ||

katyayani pratijna karila — Katyayani made a vow; yenamate — how; mahesha-samvada — the talk with Mahesha; mahaprasada-nimitte — for the sake of mahaprasada

98how Katyayani made a vow
in her talk with Mahesha for the sake of mahaprasada.10

আর অপরূপ কথা রুক্মিণী কহিল ।
শুনিঞা বিহ্বল আমি প্রতিজ্ঞা করিল ॥ ৯৯ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā rukmiṇī kahila |
śuniñā bihbala āmi pratijñā karila || 99 ||

ara aparupa katha — and something unprecedented; rukmini kahila — Rukmini said; shunina vihvala ami — hearing it, I, overwhelmed; pratijna karila — made a vow

99And Rukmini has said something unprecedented;
hearing it, I was moved and made a vow:

ভুঞ্জিব প্রেমার সুখ ভুঞ্জাইব লোকে ।
দীনভাব প্রকাশ করিব কলিযুগে ॥ ১০০ ॥

bhuñjiba premāra sukha bhuñjāiba loke |
dīnabhāba prakāśa kariba kaliyuge || 100 ||

bhunjiba premara sukha — I shall taste the happiness of prema; bhunjaiba loke — I shall make people taste it; dina-bhava prakasha kariba — I shall show a humble mood; kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga

100I shall taste the happiness of prema and give it to the people to taste;
I shall show a humble mood in the Kali-yuga;

ভকত-জনের সঙ্গে ভকতি করিয়া ।
নিজ প্রেম বিলাইব ঈশ্বর হইয়া ॥ ১০১ ॥

bhakata-janera saṅge bhakati kariẏā |
nija prema bilāiba īśbara haiẏā || 101 ||

bhakata-janera sange — with the devotees; bhakati kariya — practising bhakti; nija prema vilaiba — I shall distribute My prema; ishvara haiya — being Ishvara

101together with the devotees, practising bhakti,
I, though I am Ishvara, shall distribute My prema;

নিজগুণ-সংকীর্তন প্রকাশ করিব ।
নবদ্বীপে শচীগৃহে জনম লভিব ॥ ১০২ ॥

nijaguṇa-saṃkīrtana prakāśa kariba |
nabadbīpe śacīgṛhe janama labhiba || 102 ||

nija-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of My virtues; prakasha kariba — I shall reveal; navadvipe shachi-grihe — in Navadvipa, in Shachi's house; janama labhiba — I shall take birth

102I shall reveal the sankirtana of My virtues and names,
I shall be born in the house of Shachi in Navadvipa;

গৌর দীর্ঘ কলেবর বাহু জানু সম ।
সুমেরু সুন্দর তনু অতি অনুপম ॥ ১০৩ ॥

gaura dīrgha kalebara bāhu jānu sama |
sumeru sundara tanu ati anupama || 103 ||

gaura dirgha kalevara — a golden, tall body; bahu janu sama — arms reaching the knees; sumeru sundara tanu — a body beautiful as Sumeru; ati anupama — beyond compare

103My body will be golden and tall, My arms reaching the knees,
beautiful as Sumeru, beyond compare."

কহিতে কহিতে প্রভু গৌরতনু হৈলা ।
দেখিয়া নারদ অতি আরতি বাঢ়িলা ॥ ১০৪ ॥

kahite kahite prabhu gauratanu hailā |
dekhiẏā nārada ati ārati bāṛhilā || 104 ||

kahite kahite — while speaking; prabhu gaura-tanu haila — the Lord became golden of body; dekhiya narada — seeing, Narada; ati arati badhila — was filled with great longing

104As He said this, the Lord became golden;
seeing it, Narada was filled with great longing.

সুমেরু সুন্দর তনু প্রেমার আবেশে ।
কহয়ে লোচন গোরা-প্রথম-প্রকাশে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

sumeru sundara tanu premāra ābeśe |
kahaẏe locana gorā-prathama-prakāśe || 105 ||

sumeru sundara tanu — a body beautiful as Sumeru; premara aveshe — in the rapture of prema; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells; gora-prathama-prakashe — of Gora's first manifestation

105A body beautiful as Sumeru, in the rapture of prema —
so Lochana tells of Gora's first manifestation.

Shri-raga; disha: "Ah, Gauranga, glory, glory! — Murchha: — Ah, my prema for Gauranga — nectar! Ah, my [treasure], glory, glory!"

দেখিয়া নারদমুনি হরিষ-হিয়ায় ।
বরিষয়ে আঁখি-নীর সহস্র-ধারায় ॥ ১০৬ ॥

dekhiẏā nāradamuni hariṣa-hiẏāẏa |
bariṣaẏe āṁkhi-nīra sahasra-dhārāẏa || 106 ||

dekhiya narada-muni — gazing, the sage Narada; harisha-hiyaya — with a jubilant heart; varishaye ankhi-nira — sheds tears; sahasra-dharaya — in a thousand streams

106Gazing [at Him] with a jubilant heart, the sage Narada
sheds tears in a thousand streams.

কোটি-ইন্দু জিনি জ্যোতি কোটি-রবি-তেজে ।
কোটি-কাম জিনি রূপ গৌরবর রাজে ॥ ১০৭ ॥

koṭi-indu jini jyoti koṭi-rabi-teje |
koṭi-kāma jini rūpa gaurabara rāje || 107 ||

koti-indu jini jyoti — radiance surpassing millions of moons; koti-ravi-teje — the brilliance of millions of suns; koti-kama jini rupa — beauty surpassing millions of Kamadevas; gaura-vara raje — the peerless Gaura shines (lit. "the best golden one")

107A radiance surpassing millions of moons, a brilliance of millions of suns,
a beauty surpassing millions of Kamadevas: so shines the peerless Gaura.

ঝলমল অঙ্গতেজ চাহিতে না পারি ।
আঁখি মুদি রহে মুনি কাঁপে থরহরি ॥ ১০৮ ॥

jhalamala aṅgateja cāhite nā pāri |
āṁkhi mudi rahe muni kāṁpe tharahari || 108 ||

jhalamala anga-teja — the dazzling radiance of the body; chahite na pari — cannot be looked at; ankhi mudi rahe muni — the sage stays with eyes shut; kanpe tharahari — trembling all over

108The dazzling radiance of the body — one cannot look at it;
the sage sits with eyes shut, trembling all over.

তেজ সম্বরিয়া প্রভু নারদে নেহারে ।
অবশ নারদ দেখি ডাকে উচ্চস্বরে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

teja sambariẏā prabhu nārade nehāre |
abaśa nārada dekhi ḍāke uccasbare || 109 ||

teja sambariya — restraining His radiance; prabhu narade nehare — the Lord looks at Narada; avasha narada dekhi — seeing Narada powerless; dake uchchasvare — calls in a loud voice

109Restraining His radiance, the Lord looks at Narada
and, seeing him powerless, calls him in a loud voice.

সম্বিত পাইয়া মুনি সে-রূপ-ধেয়ানে ।
পুনঃ দরশন লাগি পিয়াস-নয়ানে ॥ ১১০ ॥

sambita pāiẏā muni se-rūpa-dheẏāne |
punaḥ daraśana lāgi piẏāsa-naẏāne || 110 ||

samvita paiya — regaining his senses; muni se-rupa-dheyane — the sage in meditation on that form; punah darashana lagi — for another sight; piyasa-nayane — with thirsting eyes

110Coming to himself, the sage [is lost] in meditation on that form,
and his eyes thirst to see [it] again.

ঠাকুর কহয়ে মুনি শুন মহাভাগ ।
অব্যাহত গতি তোর সর্বত্র সোহাগ ॥ ১১১ ॥

ṭhākura kahaẏe muni śuna mahābhāga |
abyāhata gati tora sarbatra sohāga || 111 ||

thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; muni shuna mahabhaga — sage, listen, greatly fortunate one; avyahata gati tora — your movement is unobstructed; sarvatra sohaga — everywhere you are cherished

111The Thakura says: "Sage, listen, greatly fortunate one:
your path is barred by nothing, everywhere you are honoured.

ঘোষণা করহ শিব-ব্রহ্মা-আদি-লোকে ।
গৌর অবতার মুঞি হব কলিযুগে ॥ ১১২ ॥

ghoṣaṇā karaha śiba-brahmā-ādi-loke |
gaura abatāra muñi haba kaliyuge || 112 ||

ghoshana karaha — proclaim; shiva-brahma-adi-loke — in the worlds of Shiva, Brahma and others; gaura avatara — as the descent of Gaura; muni haba kali-yuge — I shall come in the Kali-yuga

112Proclaim in the worlds of Shiva, Brahma and the others:
I shall appear in the Kali-yuga as Gaura.

গুণ-নাম-সংকীর্তন প্রকাশ করিব ।
নিজ-ভক্তি-প্রেমরস-সুখ প্রচারিব ॥ ১১৩ ॥

guṇa-nāma-saṃkīrtana prakāśa kariba |
nija-bhakti-premarasa-sukha pracāriba || 113 ||

guna-nama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of virtues and name; prakasha kariba — I shall reveal; nija-bhakti-prema-rasa-sukha — the happiness of the rasa of bhakti and prema for Me; prachariba — I shall spread

113I shall reveal the sankirtana of virtues and name,
I shall spread the happiness of the rasa of bhakti and prema for Me.

শত শত শাখা ভক্তিপথে নাহি সীমা ।
একমুখ হউ লোক প্রচারিব প্রেমা ॥ ১১৪ ॥

śata śata śākhā bhaktipathe nāhi sīmā |
ekamukha hau loka pracāriba premā || 114 ||

shata shata shakha — hundreds upon hundreds of branches; bhakti-pathe nahi sima — the paths of bhakti are limitless; eka-mukha hau loka — let people face one way; prachariba prema — I shall spread prema

114Hundreds upon hundreds of branches — the paths of bhakti are without limit;
turning people towards one, I shall spread prema.11

নিজ নিজ ভক্তজন আর পারিষদ ।
পৃথিবীতে জনম লঞা প্রেমভক্তি-সাধ ॥ ১১৫ ॥

nija nija bhaktajana āra pāriṣada |
pṛthibīte janama lañā premabhakti-sādha || 115 ||

nija nija bhakta-jana — My own devotees; ara parishada — and associates; prithivite janama lana — taking birth on earth; prema-bhakti-sadha — [I shall fulfil] the longing for prema-bhakti

115Together with My own devotees and associates,
born on earth, [I shall fulfil] the longing for prema-bhakti."

এছন শ্রীমুখ-বাণী শুনিঞা নারদ ।
খণ্ডিল সকল দুঃখ পদ-পরসাদ ॥ ১১৬ ॥

echana śrīmukha-bāṇī śuniñā nārada |
khaṇḍila sakala duḥkha pada-parasāda || 116 ||

echhana sri-mukha-vani — such words from the holy mouth; shunina narada — hearing, Narada; khandila sakala duhkha — was freed from all sorrow; pada-parasada — by the grace of the feet

116Hearing such words from the holy mouth, Narada,
by the grace of [the Lord's] feet, was freed from all sorrow.

চলিলা নারদমুনি বীণা বাজাইয়া ।
এই মনঃকথা-রসে পরবশ হঞা ॥ ১১৭ ॥

calilā nāradamuni bīṇā bājāiẏā |
ei manaḥkathā-rase parabaśa hañā || 117 ||

chalila narada-muni — the sage Narada went; vina bajaiya — playing his vina; ei manah-katha-rase — in the rasa of these thoughts; paravasha haina — absorbed

117The sage Narada went on, playing his vina,
absorbed in these thoughts:

কি দেখিনু গোরারূপ অপরূপ ঠাম ।
কি দেখিনু সকরুণ অরুণ নয়ান ॥ ১১৮ ॥

ki dekhinu gorārūpa aparūpa ṭhāma |
ki dekhinu sakaruṇa aruṇa naẏāna || 118 ||

ki dekhinu — what have I seen; gora-rupa aparupa thama — the wondrous form of Gora; ki dekhinu — what have I seen; sakaruna aruna nayana — red eyes full of compassion

118"What a wondrous form of Gora I have seen!
What red eyes full of compassion I have seen!

কি দেখিনু অমিয়া-অধিক পরকাশ ।
কি দেখিনু শ্রীমুখের মধুরিম হাস ॥ ১১৯ ॥

ki dekhinu amiẏā-adhika parakāśa |
ki dekhinu śrīmukhera madhurima hāsa || 119 ||

ki dekhinu — what have I seen; amiya-adhika parakasha — radiance sweeter than nectar; ki dekhinu — what have I seen; sri-mukhera madhurima hasa — the sweet smile of the holy lips

119What a radiance I have seen — sweeter than nectar!
What a sweet smile on the holy lips I have seen!

যত যত অবতার সভা হৈতে সার ।
কভু নাহি দেখি হেন প্রেমার ভাণ্ডার ॥ ১২০ ॥

yata yata abatāra sabhā haite sāra |
kabhu nāhi dekhi hena premāra bhāṇḍāra || 120 ||

yata yata avatara — all the descents there have been; sabha haite sara — the essence of them all; kabhu nahi dekhi — never have I seen; hena premara bhandara — such a treasure-house of prema

120Of all the descents there have been, this is the essence;
never have I seen such a treasure-house of prema.

সফল জনম মোর সফল নয়ান ।
কি দেখিনু গোরারূপ প্রসন্ন বয়ান ॥ ১২১ ॥

saphala janama mora saphala naẏāna |
ki dekhinu gorārūpa prasanna baẏāna || 121 ||

saphala janama mora — fruitful is my birth; saphala nayana — fruitful my eyes; ki dekhinu gora-rupa — I have seen Gora's form; prasanna vayana — the serene face

121Blessed is my birth, blessed are my eyes:
I have seen the form of Gora, His serene face.

এহেন করুণানিধি কভু নাহি দেখি ।
পাশরিতে নারি হিয়া জুড়াইল আঁখি ॥ ১২২ ॥

ehena karuṇānidhi kabhu nāhi dekhi |
pāśarite nāri hiẏā juṛāila āṁkhi || 122 ||

ehena karuna-nidhi — such an ocean of mercy; kabhu nahi dekhi — never have I seen; pasharite nari hiya — the heart cannot forget; judaila ankhi — the eyes are soothed

122Never have I seen such an ocean of mercy:
the heart cannot forget, my eyes are satisfied."

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে মুনি চলি যায় পথে ।
নৈমিষ-অরণ্যে দেখা উদ্ধবের সাথে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

cintite cintite muni cali yāẏa pathe |
naimiṣa-araṇye dekhā uddhabera sāthe || 123 ||

chintite chintite — pondering; muni chali yaya pathe — the sage goes on his way; naimisha-aranye — in the forest of Naimisha; dekha uddhavera sathe — meets Uddhava

123Pondering thus, the sage goes on his way,
and in the forest of Naimisha he meets Uddhava.

উদ্ধব সম্ভ্রমে উঠি পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য দিয়া ।
দণ্ডবত করে ভূমে চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ১২৪ ॥

uddhaba sambhrame uṭhi pādya arghya diẏā |
daṇḍabata kare bhūme caraṇe paṛiẏā || 124 ||

uddhava sambhrame uthi — Uddhava, rising respectfully; padya arghya diya — offering water for the feet and arghya; dandavata kare bhume — prostrates on the ground; charane padiya — falling at the feet

124Uddhava, rising respectfully, offered water for the feet and arghya
and lay prostrate on the ground, falling at his feet.

শুভদিন হেন মানে আপনাকে ধন্য ।
শুভক্ষণে আইলা মুনি নৈমিষ-অরণ্য ॥ ১২৫ ॥

śubhadina hena māne āpanāke dhanya |
śubhakṣaṇe āilā muni naimiṣa-araṇya || 125 ||

shubha-dina hena mane — he deems the day auspicious; apanake dhanya — himself fortunate; shubha-kshane — at an auspicious hour; aila muni — the sage came; naimisha-aranya — to the forest of Naimisha

125He thinks the day auspicious and himself fortunate:
"At an auspicious hour the sage has come to the forest of Naimisha."

নারদ তুলিয়া কৈলা গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন ।
চুম্বন করিয়া লৈলা মস্তকের ঘ্রাণ ॥ ১২৬ ॥

nārada tuliẏā kailā gāṛha āliṅgana |
cumbana kariẏā lailā mastakera ghrāṇa || 126 ||

narada tuliya — Narada, lifting [him]; kaila gadha alingana — embraced him tightly; chumbana kariya — kissing; laila mastakera ghrana — smelled the crown of his head

126Narada lifted him up, embraced him tightly,
kissed him and smelled the crown of his head.

উদ্ধব আনিঞা দিল আসন বসিতে ।
নিজ মনঃকথা কহে হাসিতে হাসিতে ॥ ১২৭ ॥

uddhaba āniñā dila āsana basite |
nija manaḥkathā kahe hāsite hāsite || 127 ||

uddhava anina dila — Uddhava brought and gave; asana vasite — a seat to sit on; nija manah-katha kahe — tells what is in his heart; hasite hasite — smiling

127Uddhava brought him a seat,
[Narada sat,] and, smiling, [Uddhava] tells what is in his heart:

সফল জনম মোর দিন স্বতন্তর ।
এক নিবেদিয়ে চির-বেদনা অন্তর ॥ ১২৮ ॥

saphala janama mora dina sbatantara |
eka nibediẏe cira-bedanā antara || 128 ||

saphala janama mora — fruitful is my birth; dina svatantara — a special day; eka nivediye — I shall lay before you one; chira-vedana antara — long-standing pain of the heart

128"Blessed is my birth, special is this day;
let me lay before you one long-standing pain of my heart.

পূরবে ত ব্যাস এই নৈমিষ-অরণ্যে ।
বেদ বিচারিয়া জাড্য না ঘুচিল মনে ॥ ১২৯ ॥

pūrabe ta byāsa ei naimiṣa-araṇye |
beda bicāriẏā jāḍya nā ghucila mane || 129 ||

purave ta vyasa — long ago Vyasa; ei naimisha-aranye — in this forest of Naimisha; veda vichariya — having studied the Vedas; jadya na ghuchila mane — the heaviness did not leave his mind

129Long ago Vyasa, here in the forest of Naimisha,
having studied the Vedas, was not freed from the heaviness of his mind;

তব পরসাদে কথা নিগূঢ় শুনিল ।
লোকনিস্তারণ-হেতু ভাগবত কৈল ॥ ১৩০ ॥

taba parasāde kathā nigūṛha śunila |
lokanistāraṇa-hetu bhāgabata kaila || 130 ||

taba parasade — by your grace; katha nigudha shunila — he heard the hidden truth; loka-nistarana-hetu — for the deliverance of people; bhagavata kaila — composed the Bhagavata

130by your grace he heard the hidden truth
and for the deliverance of people composed the Bhagavata.12

তুমি মাত্র তত্ত্ববেত্তা প্রভুতত্ত্ব জান ।
বুঝিয়া ঠাকুর-মন ভবিষ্য বাখান ॥ ১৩১ ॥

tumi mātra tattbabettā prabhutattba jāna |
bujhiẏā ṭhākura-mana bhabiṣya bākhāna || 131 ||

tumi matra tattva-vetta — you alone know the truth; prabhu-tattva jana — you know the truth about the Lord; bujhiya thakura-mana — understanding the Lord's mind; bhavishya bakhana — explain the future

131You alone know the truth, you know the truth about the Lord;
understanding the Lord's purpose, reveal the future:

কলিযুগে লোকের নিস্তার কেনমতে ।
পাপাবৃত অন্ধ লোক হৃদয়-নয়নে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

kaliyuge lokera nistāra kenamate |
pāpābṛta andha loka hṛdaẏa-naẏane || 132 ||

kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga; lokera nistara kenamate — how will people be saved; papavrita — wrapped in sin; andha loka hridaya-nayane — people blind in the eyes of the heart

132how will people be saved in the Kali-yuga —
wrapped in sin, the eyes of their hearts blind?

সত্য ত্রেতা দ্বাপরে লোকের ধর্ম জানি ।
ঘোর কলিযুগে আর নাহি পাপ বিনি ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

satya tretā dbāpare lokera dharma jāni |
ghora kaliyuge āra nāhi pāpa bini || 133 ||

satya treta dvapare — in the Satya, Treta and Dvapara; lokera dharma jani — I know the people's dharma; ghora kali-yuge — in the terrible Kali-yuga; ara nahi papa vini — there is nothing but sin

133I know what the dharma of people is in the Satya, Treta and Dvapara yugas;
but in the terrible Kali-yuga there is nothing but sin.

দয়া করি কহ যদি ঘুচাহ সন্দেহ ।
তোমার অধিক আর দয়াবন্ত কেহ ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

daẏā kari kaha yadi ghucāha sandeha |
tomāra adhika āra daẏābanta keha || 134 ||

daya kari kaha — be merciful, tell; yadi ghuchaha sandeha — if you would dispel my doubt; tomara adhika ara — who more than you; dayavanta keha — is merciful

134Be merciful, tell me, dispel my doubt:
who is more merciful than you?"

হাসিয়া কহয়ে মুনি অন্তর-উল্লাস ।
ভাল সুধাইলে হে উদ্ধব হরিদাস ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

hāsiẏā kahaẏe muni antara-ullāsa |
bhāla sudhāile he uddhaba haridāsa || 135 ||

hasiya kahaye muni — smiling, the sage says; antara-ullasa — rejoicing at heart; bhala sudhaile — well have you asked; he uddhava haridasa — O Uddhava, servant of Hari

135Rejoicing at heart, the sage says, smiling:
"Well have you asked, Uddhava, servant of Hari!

পরম নিগূঢ় কথা কহি তোর সনে ।
এছন আছিল শোক বড় মোর মনে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

parama nigūṛha kathā kahi tora sane |
echana āchila śoka baṛa mora mane || 136 ||

parama nigudha katha — the deepest secret; kahi tora sane — I tell you; echhana achhila shoka — such grief there was; bada mora mane — great in my heart

136I will tell you the deepest secret:
the very same grief was in my heart too.

এখনে জানিল মুঞি কলিযুগ ধন্য ।
কলিলোক বহি ধন্য আর নাহি অন্য ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

ekhane jānila muñi kaliyuga dhanya |
kaliloka bahi dhanya āra nāhi anya || 137 ||

ekhane janila muni — now I have understood; kali-yuga dhanya — the Kali-yuga is blessed; kali-loka bahi — apart from the people of Kali; dhanya ara nahi anya — none other is so blessed

137Now I have understood: the Kali-yuga is blessed;
apart from the people of Kali, there is no one else so blessed.

সত্য-আদি-যুগধর্ম আচার কঠিন ।
কলিযুগ-ধর্ম হরিনাম পরবীণ ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

satya-ādi-yugadharma ācāra kaṭhina |
kaliyuga-dharma harināma parabīṇa || 138 ||

satya-adi-yuga-dharma — the dharma of Satya and other yugas; achara kathina — severe practices; kali-yuga-dharma — the dharma of the Kali-yuga; hari-nama paravina — the excellent Hari-nama

138The dharma of the Satya and the other yugas is a severe discipline;
the dharma of the Kali-yuga is the excellent Hari-nama.13

নাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তনে মুক্তবন্ধ হঞা ।
নৃত্যগীতে বুলে যমভয় এড়াইয়া ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

nāma-guṇa-saṃkīrtane muktabandha hañā |
nṛtyagīte bule yamabhaẏa eṛāiẏā || 139 ||

nama-guna-sankirtane — by the sankirtana of the name and virtues; mukta-bandha haina — freed from bondage; nritya-gite bule — they go about dancing and singing; yama-bhaya edaiya — escaping the fear of Yama

139By the sankirtana of the name and virtues they are freed from bondage;
they go about dancing and singing, free from the fear of Yama.

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
দ্বারকায় দেখিলাম আপন নয়ানে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā śuna sābadhāne |
dbārakāẏa dekhilāma āpana naẏāne || 140 ||

ara aparupa katha — another wonder; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; dvarakaya dekhilama — what I saw in Dvaraka; apana nayane — with my own eyes

140And here is another wonder — listen attentively —
which I saw with my own eyes in Dvaraka.

এই কথা-রসে প্রভু রুক্মিণীর সাথে ।
নিজ প্রেম বিলসিব করি হেন চিতে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

ei kathā-rase prabhu rukmiṇīra sāthe |
nija prema bilasiba kari hena cite || 141 ||

ei katha-rase — in the delight of this talk; prabhu rukminira sathe — the Lord with Rukmini; nija prema vilasiba — I will unfold My prema; kari hena chite — so resolved in His heart

141Speaking of this with Rukmini, the Lord
resolved in His heart: 'I will unfold My prema.'

সিংহাসনে বসিয়া রুক্মিণী করি কোলে ।
অন্তর-চিন্তিত মুঞি গেনু হেনকালে ॥ ১৪২ ॥

siṃhāsane basiẏā rukmiṇī kari kole |
antara-cintita muñi genu henakāle || 142 ||

simhasane vasiya — sitting on the throne; rukmini kari kole — with Rukmini on His lap; antara-chintita — troubled at heart; muni genu henakale — I came at that time

142He was sitting on the throne with Rukmini on His lap —
at that time I arrived, troubled at heart.

দুঃখিত দেখিয়া প্রভু পুছিল আমারে ।
এহেন মূরতি কেনে দেখিয়ে তোমারে ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

duḥkhita dekhiẏā prabhu puchila āmāre |
ehena mūrati kene dekhiẏe tomāre || 143 ||

duhkhita dekhiya — seeing me sorrowful; prabhu puchhila amare — the Lord asked me; ehena murati — in such a state; kene dekhiye tomare — why do I see you

143Seeing me in sorrow, the Lord asked me:
'Why do I see you like this?'

এই মনঃকথা মুঞি কহিনু পদ পাঞা ।
প্রসন্ন বয়ানে প্রভু কহিলা হাসিয়া ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

ei manaḥkathā muñi kahinu pada pāñā |
prasanna baẏāne prabhu kahilā hāsiẏā || 144 ||

ei manah-katha — this thought; muni kahinu — I told; pada pana — reaching His feet; prasanna vayane — with a serene face; prabhu kahila hasiya — the Lord said, smiling

144Falling at His feet, I told Him what was in my heart;
the Lord, His face serene, said smiling:

রুক্মিণী কহিল পদ-প্রেমার মহিমা ।
শুনিঞা বিহ্বল প্রভু আরতি-গরিমা ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

rukmiṇī kahila pada-premāra mahimā |
śuniñā bihbala prabhu ārati-garimā || 145 ||

rukmini kahila — Rukmini told; pada-premara mahima — the greatness of love for the feet; shunina vihvala prabhu — hearing it, the Lord is overwhelmed; arati-garima — so great the longing

145'Rukmini has told the greatness of love for [My] feet;
hearing it, I am overwhelmed — so great is [this] longing.

ভুঞ্জিব প্রেমার সুখ ভুঞ্জাইব লোকে ।
দীনভাব প্রকাশ করিব কলিযুগে ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

bhuñjiba premāra sukha bhuñjāiba loke |
dīnabhāba prakāśa kariba kaliyuge || 146 ||

bhunjiba premara sukha — I shall taste the happiness of prema; bhunjaiba loke — I shall make people taste it; dina-bhava prakasha kariba — I shall show a humble mood; kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga

146I shall taste the happiness of prema and give it to the people to taste;
I shall show a humble mood in the Kali-yuga.

ঘোর কলিযুগ পাপময় ধর্মহীন ।
লোক বুঝাবার তরে হব মুঞি দীন ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

ghora kaliyuga pāpamaẏa dharmahīna |
loka bujhābāra tare haba muñi dīna || 147 ||

ghora kali-yuga — the terrible Kali-yuga; papamaya dharmahina — sinful, without dharma; loka bujhabara tare — to make people understand; haba muni dina — I shall become humble

147The terrible Kali-yuga is sinful, without dharma;
to bring people to understanding, I shall become very humble.'

প্রেমময় গৌর দীর্ঘ সুবরণ তনু ।
বিশাল হৃদয় বাহু-যুগ সম জানু ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

premamaẏa gaura dīrgha subaraṇa tanu |
biśāla hṛdaẏa bāhu-yuga sama jānu || 148 ||

premamaya — full of prema; gaura dirgha suvarana tanu — a golden, tall body of lovely hue; vishala hridaya — a broad chest; bahu-yuga sama janu — both arms reaching the knees

148A body full of prema, golden, tall, of lovely hue,
a broad chest, arms reaching the knees —

কহিতে কহিতে প্রভু গৌরতনু হৈলা ।
নিজ প্রেম বিলাইব প্রতিজ্ঞা করিলা ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

kahite kahite prabhu gauratanu hailā |
nija prema bilāiba pratijñā karilā || 149 ||

kahite kahite — while speaking; prabhu gaura-tanu haila — the Lord became golden of body; nija prema vilaiba — "I shall give away My prema"; pratijna karila — He vowed

149as He said this, the Lord became golden
and vowed to give away His prema.

যে দেখিল যে শুনিল কহিল তোমারে ।
ঘোষণা দিবারে যাব সকল সংসারে ॥ ১৫০ ॥

ye dekhila ye śunila kahila tomāre |
ghoṣaṇā dibāre yāba sakala saṃsāre || 150 ||

ye dekhila — what I saw; ye shunila — what I heard; kahila tomare — I have told you; ghoshana dibare — to proclaim; yaba sakala samsare — I shall go through the whole world

150What I saw, what I heard, I have told you;
I shall go and proclaim it throughout the world.

পৃথিবীতে জন্ম গিয়া প্রেমভক্তি-লোভে ।
হেন অপরূপ প্রভু হবে কলিযুগে ॥ ১৫১ ॥

pṛthibīte janma giẏā premabhakti-lobhe |
hena aparūpa prabhu habe kaliyuge || 151 ||

prithivite janma giya — taking birth on earth; prema-bhakti-lobhe — out of longing for prema-bhakti; hena aparupa prabhu — so wondrous a Lord; habe kali-yuge — will be in the Kali-yuga

151Taking birth on earth out of longing for prema-bhakti,
so wondrous [the Lord] will appear in the Kali-yuga."

শুনিয়া নারদ-বাণী উদ্ধব বিকল ।
চরণে পড়িয়া কান্দে আনন্দে বিহ্বল ॥ ১৫২ ॥

śuniẏā nārada-bāṇī uddhaba bikala |
caraṇe paṛiẏā kānde ānande bihbala || 152 ||

shuniya narada-vani — hearing Narada's words; uddhava vikala — Uddhava beside himself; charane padiya kande — weeps fallen at his feet; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with joy

152Hearing Narada's words, Uddhava, beside himself,
weeps, fallen at his feet, overwhelmed with joy:

হেন অদভুত কথা কহিলে আমারে ।
জীব সঞ্চারিলে যেন নির্জীব শরীরে ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

hena adabhuta kathā kahile āmāre |
jība sañcārile yena nirjība śarīre || 153 ||

hena adabhuta katha — such a wondrous thing; kahile amare — you have told me; jiva sancharile yena — as though you breathed life; nirjiva sharire — into a lifeless body

153"You have told me such a wondrous thing —
as though life were breathed into a lifeless body.

✦

Notes

  1. So in Bhaktisiddhanta's text (A: "amiya"): people take these passions for nectar. The 1983 edition has "sprinkle their hearts with poison".
  2. Literally "the Thakura of Dvaraka, crest-jewel of the God of gods".
  3. Mitravinda and Nagnajiti are among Krishna's principal queens (Bhag. 10.58). Sushila and Subala may also be names of queens, or epithets ("good-natured, youthful"); we take them as names.
  4. Nirmanchhana: the rite of waving a lamp or other object around a beloved person to ward off all harm.
  5. Cf. Bhag. 10.60: Krishna in jest told Rukmini that she should have chosen a king equal to her as husband, and she fainted from grief.
  6. Literally "then You will know the marks of Your own love", i.e. the love directed to You.
